# harborpilot_auth_settings (Resource)

The server's authentication settings (a singleton). Creating it adopts the current settings; destroying it only removes it from state and leaves the settings as they are. Disabling password sign-in requires an enabled SSO provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_auth_settings" "this" {
  password_login           = true
  idle_timeout_seconds     = 1800
  absolute_timeout_seconds = 43200
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `absolute_timeout_seconds` (Number) Session absolute lifetime (300–2592000).
- `idle_timeout_seconds` (Number) Session idle timeout (300–86400).
- `password_login` (Boolean) Allow local password sign-in.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harborpilot_auth_settings.this auth_settings
```
